about: SCION 22 asset ledger. Nothing from the kit, the archive or the web is used: every piece of picture and sound is drawn or synthesized by the scripts in build/.

assets.what: the felt material: a 1024 px fibre tile (90,000 short random fibres + low-frequency mottling), fuzzy cut edges, drop shadows, running stitches

the dog: layered puppet, named groups (Dog/Body/<view>/Torso, Saddle, Bib, Haunch, Shoulder; Dog/Legs/FN FF HN HF + Paw; Dog/Neck + Collar + Tag; Dog/Head/<view>/Skull, Cap, Muzzle, Nose, Mouth, Eye*/White Iris Pupil Glint Blink Brow, Ear near/far + Inner; Dog/Tail + Tip). Swap sets: body Side/Quarter/Back (mirrored), head Profile/QFront/QBack/Back
assets.source: build/rig.py (outlines drawn as Catmull-Rom control points in metres); tree exported to puppet/puppets.json
assets.note: coat pattern (tan, dark saddle, cream chest and muzzle) is my own; no reference image was traced

assets.what: the person: layered felt puppet, three-quarter view; mouth swap set of 12 visemes; ponytail dangle; limb IK
assets.note: not a real or identifiable person

assets.what: the felt-board set: dusk sky, moon, stitched stars, hills, trees, porch (deck, rail, post, roof, steps), house section (room, wallpaper, lamp, picture, bench, inner hall doorway, wall section, far door casing, sill), door leaf
five takes (timed control tracks): capture (the PAELEO score's dog act tracks verbatim), triggers, head & body turner, eye gaze, person
assets.operation: recorded as tracks; editor corrections listed in takes.json

assets.what: the person's five lines (Come here! x2, It's all right. x2, Come in.)
assets.source: build/voice.py (Klatt-style cascade formant synthesis, Rosenberg glottal pulse)
assets.operation: synthesized; no recording, no TTS engine
computed from the voice audio only (RMS, voicing, band-energy openness/frontness)

assets.what: crickets, air, claws on boards at the Walk behaviour's footfalls, collar tag, thumps and sighs, steps, bench, door creak (stick-slip pulses), clock and room hum after the door opens
card fonts Big Shoulders Display, JetBrains Mono
assets.source: tools/paeleo/fonts/ (repository copies, SIL Open Font License)
